biography.plain_text: Alvin Kimble is a Louisiana telecommunications businessman who owned and led Star Telephone, serving communities around Baton Rouge and elsewhere in the state. He developed cellular ventures alongside the landline business and became a partner in Cellular 7. Star Telephone was subsequently acquired by the Idaho company Direct Communications Rockland.

long_biography.plain_text:
Telecommunications executive Alvin Kimble brought detailed financial scrutiny to Louisiana State University's governing board, where he chaired its finance, infrastructure and core development committee. When renovation costs for the student union and theatre exceeded estimates, the committee considered how much students should pay.

Kimble described reviewing each budget item and seeking contributions from users other than students. The resulting revisions required the university to contribute in proportion to its use of the facilities. They also provided for student fees to fall if costs were lower than expected, private funding became available or the renovation bonds were repaid.

They also provided for student fees to fall if costs were lower than expected, private funding became available or the renovation bonds were repaid.
